text.p: Tropical Storm Peter, with 65 mph winds, is near 21.4n/126.6e, moving north at 11 mph. It will intensify to a typhoon with top winds reaching 80 mph during the next 36 hours, moving into the waters east of Taiwan. After that, it will turn northeastward and weaken. Peter is mainly a threat to shipping.

Tropical Storm Carlos, with 40 mph winds, is in the eastern Pacific near 17.9n/110.8w, moving west northwest at 11 mph. Carlos will continue this track and strength through the next 36 hours. It will be a moderate threat to shipping but no threat to land.
There are no further statements at this time.
